title: Storm Sorceress
description: A female sorceress with long flowing white hair stands dynamically above turbulent ocean waves, casting blue magical energy from her hands. She wears ornate golden and white armor as a swirling vortex of storm clouds, lightning, orange embers, and a starry cosmic sky with constellations surround her.
prompt: A powerful female sorceress with long flowing white hair stands above crashing ocean waves, wearing ornate golden and white armor. She casts swirling blue magical chains and lightning from her outstretched hands while a massive vortex of dark storm clouds, glowing orange embers, and a starry purple cosmic sky with constellations swirl around her in a dramatic dynamic pose.
